segments.text: Ok so this is the Tool Rendering page for OpenAI Agents with Angular, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, the tool handler fetches slash api slash weather, and the page never gives that endpoint.
And it promises the card shows the city and the tool result.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. I asked for the weather, it should show the weather on the card, but the result is just the app's HTML page.
So basically, the handler calls an API the page never shows.
So the tool never gets real weather back.
That's the problem here, please have a look.
